IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BATCHCT1.
      * CHAIN STEP 1 - SETS THE PENALTY-RUN CONTROL FLAG
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       COPY WSCTLFLG.
       01  WS-CYCLE-DAY              PIC 9(2) VALUE ZERO.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-CYCLE-DAY
           IF WS-CYCLE-DAY = 1
              MOVE 'N' TO WS-PEN-RUN-FLAG
           END-IF
           DISPLAY 'PENFLAG: ' WS-PEN-RUN-FLAG
           STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BATCHCT2.
      * CHAIN STEP 2 - PENALTY ACCRUAL GUARDED BY CONTROL FLAG
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       COPY WSCTLFLG.
       01  WS-DELAY-DAYS             PIC 9(4) VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-PENALTY                PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-PEN-RUN-FLAG
           ACCEPT WS-DELAY-DAYS
           IF PEN-RUN-ON
              PERFORM 2000-ACCRUE
           END-IF
           DISPLAY 'PEN: ' WS-PENALTY
           STOP RUN.
       2000-ACCRUE.
           COMPUTE WS-PENALTY = 500 * WS-DELAY-DAYS.

* BATCH CONTROL FLAGS SHARED ACROSS THE PENALTY CHAIN
       01  WS-CTL-FLAGS.
           05  WS-PEN-RUN-FLAG       PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
               88  PEN-RUN-ON        VALUE 'Y'.
